description: Checks whether a company is likely to fit Datari Labs' referral criteria (30+ staff, 3+ years of kept records, UK/EU/US). Read-only: does not register anything. Use before suggesting a company register.

country.description: Country the company is based in, e.g. 'United Kingdom'

record_types.description: Optional: kinds of records kept, e.g. ['email','chat','crm','tickets']

years_of_records.description: How many years of operational records (email, chat, CRM, tickets, logs) the company has kept

name: check_fit
title: Check company fit
